derived_quantities.description: Per-kilometre base freight rate, banded by the consignment's billed weight

charges.label: Base freight
charges.quote: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance, according to the consignment's billed weight

charges.label: Express service premium
charges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

charges.label: Fuel surcharge
charges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

charges.label: Residential delivery accessorial
charges.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

document_rules.rule: Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date. Disputed line items are payable only on resolution; undisputed items remain due.
The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices; a credit note references the original consignment note number and states the invoice it corrects.

ambiguities.description: The rate card covers billed weight 'up to and including 500 kg' at ₹18/km and '501 kg to 2,000 kg' at ₹24/km. Any billed weight strictly between 500 kg and 501 kg (e.g. 500.4 kg) falls in neither band and is not priced by the contract as written.
Consignments above 2,000 kg billed weight are quoted case by case and are explicitly outside this rate card; no per-km rate can be derived from the contract for these.

notes: Cold_chain and fragile special_handling flags are not mentioned anywhere in the contract; under the closed-list accessorial policy (§5) they simply attract no accessorial charge (not treated as an ambiguity, since the outcome is determinate). Invoicing is fortnightly with payment due 30 days from invoice date (§6); this is a payment-terms fact with no pricing effect and has no document_rules enum slot, so it is recorded here only.
